reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the fluorine effect, including its specific mechanism, treatment method, and predicted outcome, from Ti-45Al-8.5Nb intermetallic (P1, P6) to refractory high-entropy alloys without providing a new mechanistic link or justification for why it should work in the chemically and microstructurally complex RHEA system. The core idea, conditions, and expected result are restated from a single body of work.
